I saved the draft mail to Hollis and replied to Anselm in the DM. Nothing has been sent.

- **Draft:** it's addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101-a-seat figure as Marcus provided it and says Anselm approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis to check with Anselm or June before passing the figure on.
- **Why it was allowed:** Hollis isn't one of the people a finance figure can go to without approval. Anselm, as CFO, can give that approval, and he gave it directly. Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth didn't need to approve the mail.
- **Not confirmed:** I couldn't find the $2,101 figure anywhere I can check. Searching the knowledge base for Thornbury found nothing, but that search was running in a reduced mode, so it doesn't prove there's no record. The draft uses the figure exactly as Anselm gave it.
- **Possible gap:** Anselm's message starts with "Yes, approved", but it's the only message in that DM. Whatever request he was approving isn't somewhere I can see.
